items.difficulty_reason: Explicit \'etale reduction: the problem is \'etale local on $B$ and $Y$ by the three cited locality lemmas, so $B, Y$ may be taken affine schemes; openness of $|X| \to |Y|$ yields an affine $U$ \'etale over $X$ mapping surjectively to $Y$; the scheme-side permanence lemma concludes.
